title: GSA Technology Accountability Act
official_summary:
GSA Technology Accountability Act

This act requires the General Services Administration to report annually to Congress on each program funded by (1) the Federal Citizen Services Fund, or (2) the Acquisition Services Fund for technology transformation services.

The reports must include a list of each program funded by such expenditures during the previous fiscal year, or that have been funded by such expenditures in the previous five-year period, along with the following information for each program: 

  • an explanation of the program;
  • information about how the program is funded;
  • a description of projects or initiatives associated with the program;
  • if applicable, the amount of reimbursements associated with or anticipated to be associated with the program from other sources of funds or another agency; and
  • if applicable, any additional information, data, or analysis used to determine the information estimated within the report.

The amendments made by this act shall take effect at the start of the first fiscal year after the date of the enactment.

summary.headline: Requires the General Services Administration to send Congress a yearly report on technology programs paid for by two specific funds.
summary.what_it_does: The General Services Administration (GSA) must report to Congress every year on each program paid for by the Federal Citizen Services Fund or by the Acquisition Services Fund for technology transformation services. The report must list programs funded in the past fiscal year or at any point in the past five years. For each program, it must explain what the program does, how it is funded, and what projects are part of it. Where it applies, the report must also list money repaid by other agencies or funds and the data used to make its estimates.

who_it_affects.how: The agency must prepare and send a detailed yearly report to Congress on certain technology programs and how they are funded.

who_it_affects.group: Members of Congress and their committees
who_it_affects.how: They will receive yearly information on what GSA technology programs do and how they are paid for.

who_it_affects.group: Other federal agencies that pay GSA for technology services
who_it_affects.how: Their repayments to GSA for these programs must be listed in the reports where they apply.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: At the start of the first fiscal year after enactment, which is October 1, 2025.
